title: Urutonde rwo kwisuzuma – Ubuzima n'ingirabuzimafatizo
subject: Biologi
intro: Uru rutonde rukurikira intambwe z'ingenzi z'igitabo cyo kwiga. Shyiraho ikimenyetso ku byo wumva ufitiye icyizere, intambwe ku yindi. Ingingo z'ubumenyi bwimbitse ziri hasi ni iz'ushaka kujya kure kurushaho.

sections.title: 1. Ubuzima ni iki? (M1)
items: Nzi ibimenyetso bitandatu biranga ubuzima kandi nzi ko ikizima cyose kibigira byose icyarimwe.
Nshobora kumenya niba ikintu kizima cyangwa kitazima hifashishijwe ibyo bimenyetso.
Nzi icyo ijambo biyoloji risobanura.
Nzi ko ikiremwa kizima kinitwa ikizima (organism).

sections.title: 2. Ingirabuzimafatizo – igice gito cy'ubuzima (M2)
items: Nzi ko ingirabuzimafatizo ari yo ngingo ntoya cyane ifite ubuzima.
Nzi itandukaniro hagati y'ibinyabuzima bifite ingirabuzimafatizo imwe n'ibifite ingirabuzimafatizo nyinshi kandi nshobora gutanga ingero.
Nzi ko ingirabuzimafatizo zororoka binyuze mu kugabanuka kw'ingirabuzimafatizo.
Nzi urukurikirane ingirabuzimafatizo → ingirangingo → ingingo kandi nshobora gutanga urugero rw'ingingo.

sections.title: 3. Ibice by'ingirabuzimafatizo – organelles (M3)
items: Nshobora kuvuga uruhu rw'ingirabuzimafatizo, sitoplazime, intangangingo, mitokondiriya na ribozomu kandi nkavuga icyo bikora.
Nzi ko intangangingo irimo ibikoresho ngengabuzima (ADN) kandi ikayobora ingirabuzimafatizo.
Nzi ko mitokondiriya ari sentrali y'ingirabuzimafatizo naho ribozomu ikaba uruganda rwayo rwa proteyine.
Nzi ibice bitatu ingirabuzimafatizo y'igihingwa ifite ariko iy'inyamaswa idafite: uruzitiro rw'ingirabuzimafatizo, korloplasite na vakuwole nini.
Nzi ko fotosintezi ikorerwa muri korloplasite.

sections.title: 4. Ubuzima muri mikorosikopi (M4)
items: Nzi ko ingirabuzimafatizo yo mu itama ari iy'inyamaswa kandi nshobora kwerekana kuri yo uruhu rw'ingirabuzimafatizo, sitoplazime n'intangangingo.
Nzi impamvu ingirabuzimafatizo yo mu itama idafite uruzitiro rw'ingirabuzimafatizo na korloplasite.
Nzi ko ingirabuzimafatizo z'ibihingwa zishobora kugaragara ku isonga ry'umuzi w'igitunguru.
Nzi icyo infusion y'ubwatsi bwumye ari cyo n'uko dushobora kubonamo inyamaswa zifite ingirabuzimafatizo imwe.
Nshobora gusobanura ko paramesiyumu ari inyamaswa ifite ingirabuzimafatizo imwe ikorera ibikorwa byose by'ubuzima mu ngirabuzimafatizo imwe gusa.

sections.title: 5. Bagiteri na virusi (M5)
items: Nzi ko bagiteri ifite ingirabuzimafatizo imwe kandi yororoka binyuze mu kugabanuka.
Nshobora gutanga ingero z'uko bagiteri zigira akamaro (ibibora, vitamini zo mu mara).
Nzi ko virusi atari ingirabuzimafatizo kandi ko akenshi itabarwa nk'ikizima.
Nshobora gusobanura impamvu antibiyotike zifasha ku bagiteri ariko zidafasha ku virusi.

sections.title: 6. Gutondeka no guha amazina ibinyabuzima (M6)
items: Nshobora gusobanura icyo ubwoko (species) ari cyo.
Nzi icyo ivanze (hybrid) ari cyo kandi nshobora gutanga urugero (urugero: mule).
Nzi Carl von Linné uwo ari we n'uko yahaye ubwoko amazina agizwe n'amagambo abiri.
Nzi ko ibinyabuzima byose bigabanyijemo domaine eshatu.

sections.title: ★ Ubumenyi bwimbitse
sections.note: Ku wowe ushaka kujya kure kurushaho – bihuye n'udusanduku tw'ubumenyi bwimbitse mu gitabo cyo kwiga.
items: Nshobora kuvuga Golgi apparatus na endoplasmic reticulum n'ibyo bikora mu ncamake.
Nshobora gusobanura icyo kudahangarwa n'antibiyotike (antibiotic resistance) ari cyo n'impamvu tugomba gukoresha antibiyotike tugereranyije.
Nshobora gusobanura impamvu ifarashi n'indogobe bibarwa nk'ubwoko butandukanye nubwo bishobora kubyara umwana.
